ck: (31)kasitinanacarya hetukatakacaranatikaranatvan vastavaneva nivistanityasayena sankate — nanviti vyavaharikasatarananatikaranatvaneva hetukatakanityasayena sanatate katasyeti pratipasikanEkantyan tu na tusananiti pava anyata katasya katatvan prati vyavaharikatikaranatvanankikare niratikaranatveneti katatirikte tatrsatikaranatvasyasanpavitatvatiti pava svasananatikaranatyantapavapratiyokitvasvatyantapavasananatikaranatvayoravisesataha — svatyantapaveti anavacinantavisesananavyapyavrtyapavanatravarakaniti nanvano tarsayati — nanviti na ca pate patatvatikaranatvasyapi nityatvena tatapavasatvana vyatirekavyapicara iti vacyan vyatirekini pratiyokivyatikaranasatanapavanirupitavyaptereva prayocakatvat pate patatvatikaranatvapavasya ca pratiyokisananatikaranatvat anyata prtivitvapavavyapakapavapratiyokisanyokavatvena calatO prtivitvasitiprasankat anavacinantatanateva nayan tosa iti sanatate ata eveti etatrsatosaprasankatapityarta heturhetukatakapava prati yokiti atEvan katatvatyapavasyapi katatO pratiyokisananatikaranatvena pratiyokisananatiranyavacetakanavacinapavaprasitiriti cetatrahu pratiyokisananatikaranyasya nirupakataya yatavacetakan tatanavacinapatavrtikatyantapavapratiyokitarnavatvan vivaksitan katatvatyapavasca patatO tatrsa iti naprasitiriti tatasat pratiyokyatikaranasya pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakatvena nivesane picapavat yatu pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacinetyasya pratiyokyanatiranatvena patavisesane tatparyanaprasitiriti tacintyan tatasati pratiyokyanatikaranetyanuktva pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacinetyuktO picapavaprasankat avyapyavrtyatikaranatvasyavyapyavrtitve sanyokanatayanEkantyaca vastutastu paranate apavananatikaranatnakatvat katanistakatatvapavasya pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakavacinatvepi patanistapavasya tatanavacinatvanavyahataneva na ca pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakiputakatatvapavatvasyEkyana patanistapavasya tatanavacinatvasanpava iti vacyan anuyokitavisesarupapavatvasyapavapetena pinatvat atava pratiyokisananatikaranyarupan yatavacetakan, visesanan tatanavacinatvan tatvisistapinatvaniti yavat tatupalaksitapinatvasya paranate patavrtitvavisistakatatvapavatavapavepi tatvisistapinatvanaksataneva patavrtitvavisistasanyokatyapave ca na pratiyokisananatikaranyavisistapinatvaniti na kascitosa paranate pratiyokisananatikaranyavacetakanavacinapavaprasitirityasankate — nanu tarhiti katapatayorapetan vatatapi tvaya, pate katatvatyantapavasya pratiyokyasananatikaranakatatvapavankikaryatvatiti sanpanta nanu katapatayorapete
